title: 第十七章 难忘阿夏第十八章 警花倾心
content_zh:
“哎呀我去，小宝！”
惊叫一声，殷东赶紧冲进屋去，就看到小宝趴在枕头上，没哭，正在啃奶糕。
听医生说小宝现在不能光吃牛奶，要加辅食，殷东昨天就买了些婴儿米糕和小馒头之类的回来，晚上小宝抓了一小袋奶糕在床上玩，他还真没想到这小子能撒开包装纸。
“儿子，你行啊，都能自己找吃的了。”
殷东笑道。
下一秒，他知道自己错了。
手摇着奶瓶的王海娇，从外面笑吟吟走过来，白了殷东一眼，朝着小宝说：“小宝，喊我啊，喊我就给你奶喝。”
“麻麻……奶……奶！”
小宝眼珠子都放光了，一爪子掀开他爸，朝王海娇挥舞着小爪子，嗷嗷的叫着，小模样萌得一脸血。
“真乖。”
王海娇笑着，将小宝抱了起来。
殷东看着她脸上浮现着似母性的光辉，有些感动着，又带着几分内疚。
“干嘛一直这样盯着我看？没见过人家喂奶啊？”
王海娇脸颊有些热，娇嗔一声。
“呃……”
殷东嘴角抽搐了两下，总感觉好像哪里不太对。
“好你个东子，趁我不在，敢偷看我姐喂奶！”
刚回来的王海生从外面冲进来，笑得极其猥琐。
“别说得这么暧昧，也不怕毁了你姐的清誉。”
殷东有些尴尬了，主要是王海娇的眼神太热辣，忙转移话题：“你没出海？”

“没呢，我爸听说可以跟顾家的海产公司签合同，要我先把这个事办了。”
说完，王海生表情有些复杂的说：“我爸说要代表村委会请顾文吃饭，让你帮忙约一下顾文。”
打了个呵欠，殷东说：“吃个毛线！
这事儿跟村里屁关系也没有，以后你自家打的渔，或者在村里收了渔获，就去县里顾文家的海产公司卖。
你只要把好质量关，这条财路就是你自己的。”
王海生有点怕他爸，犹豫说：“我爸是村长……”
“两码事，不相干。”
殷东干脆利落的打断了他的话。
前世，小宝被卖掉后，他完全失去了理智，在他奶奶的误导下，还有二婶混淆黑白的挑拨离间中，他把小宝失踪的责任怪到了王海生姐弟头上，以至于跟王家姐弟最终断绝来往。
这一世，他想要补偿王海生，才跟顾文开那个口的。
“你听东子的吧，别管爸怎么说，姐给你本钱，以后你自己在村里收货，再卖出去，那钱不要给家里。”
王海娇说着，看殷东在点头，又说：“这个事情是东子找的关系，你俩干脆合伙做生意，各占一半股份。
我反正很闲，你们忙的时候，我可以帮着带小宝。”
“我姐想得太周到了，我同意，就这么办。”
王海生立马表示赞成。
“我就算了，我自己打渔，到时候东子帮我卖出去就行了。”
殷东说。
他可不想占王海生的便宜，更不想让王海娇照顾。
他带一个孩子，家里又穷得叮当响，王海娇爸妈看不上他，他又何必自取其辱……好吧，所有的一切都是借口，真正的原因是他忘不了阿夏，只想一家团圆。
尤其是出现了一个酷肖阿夏的秋莹，他现在一门心思就在想怎么证明秋莹就是阿夏！
content_en:
"Oh, I'll go, Xiaobao!"
With a scream, Yin Dong rushed into the room and saw Xiaobao lying on the pillow, not crying, and eating milk cake.
Hearing from the doctor that Xiaobao can't just eat milk now, he needs to add complementary foods. Yin Dong bought some baby rice cakes and steamed buns yesterday. At night, Xiaobao grabbed a small bag of milk cake and played with it on the bed. He really didn't expect this kid to be able to open the wrapping paper.
"Son, you can do it. You can find food by yourself."
Yin Dong smiled.
The next second, he knew he was wrong.
Wang Haijiao, who was holding a milk bottle in her hand, came over with a smile from outside, rolled her eyes at Yin Dong, and said to Xiaobao: "Xiaobao, call me, and I will give you milk."
"Mama...milk...milk!"
Xiaobao's eyes shone brightly, he lifted his father away with his paw, waved his little paw towards Wang Haijiao, and squealed, looking so cute that his face was bloody.
"So good."
Wang Haijiao smiled and picked up Xiaobao.
Yin Dong saw the motherly glow on her face, feeling a little moved and a little guilty.
"Why do you keep staring at me like this? Have you never seen someone breastfeeding?"
Wang Haijiao's cheeks felt a little hot and she let out a squeak.
"Uh..."
The corners of Yin Dong's mouth twitched twice, feeling that something was not right.
"You're such a bastard, how dare you peek at my sister breastfeeding while I'm not around!"
Wang Haisheng, who had just returned, rushed in from outside and smiled extremely obscenely.
"Don't speak so ambiguously, and you're not afraid of ruining your sister's reputation."
Yin Dong was a little embarrassed, mainly because Wang Haijiao's eyes were too hot, so he quickly changed the subject: "You didn't go to sea?"
"No, my dad heard that we can sign a contract with the Gu family's seafood company and asked me to take care of this matter first."
After saying that, Wang Haisheng said with a complicated expression: "My dad said that he would invite Gu Wen to dinner on behalf of the village committee, and asked you to help make an appointment with Gu Wen."
Yawning, Yin Dong said: "Eat some wool!
This matter has nothing to do with the village. From now on, if you catch fish at home or harvest it in the village, you can sell it to Gu Wen's seafood company in the county.
As long as you control the quality well, this way of making money is your own. "
Wang Haisheng was a little afraid of his father and said hesitantly: "My father is the village chief..."
"Two different things, irrelevant."
Yin Dong interrupted him neatly.
In his previous life, after Xiaobao was sold, he completely lost his mind. Under the misguidance of his grandmother and the misunderstanding of his second aunt, he blamed the Wang Haisheng siblings for Xiaobao's disappearance, so that he eventually severed contact with the Wangs.
In this life, he wanted to make up for Wang Haisheng, so he spoke to Gu Wen.
"Just listen to Dongzi. Don't care what dad says. Sister will give you the capital. From now on, you can collect the goods in the village and sell them. Don't give the money to the family."
Wang Haijiao said, seeing Yin Dong nodding, he added: "This matter was brought about by Dongzi. You two should just go into business together, each holding half of the shares.
I'm very free anyway. When you are busy, I can help take care of Xiaobao. "
"My sister is so thoughtful. I agree, let's do it."
Wang Haisheng immediately agreed.
"I'll forget it, I'll fish by myself, and Dongzi will just help me sell it when the time comes."
Yin Dong said.
He didn't want to take advantage of Wang Haisheng, let alone let Wang Haijiao take care of him.
He was raising a child, and his family was extremely poor. Wang Haijiao's parents looked down on him, so why should he humiliate himself... Well, everything was an excuse. The real reason was that he couldn't forget Axia and just wanted to reunite his family.
Especially when Qiu Ying, who looks like A Xia, appeared, he was now thinking about how to prove that Qiu Ying was A Xia!
